description.zh: 微信知识库问答：DSH 里收发微信消息，同时带一个本地知识库（导入 Word/Excel/PDF/图片/音频，图片 OCR、检索引用、复习提示词）。由 dsh-wechat-bridge 与 dsh-project-knowledge-review 原样合并，设置页合成一页。
description.en: WeChat + local knowledge base for DSH: send and receive WeChat messages, and keep a local knowledge base (import Word/Excel/PDF/images/audio, image OCR, retrieval with citations). A straight merge of dsh-wechat-bridge and dsh-project-knowledge-review with one combined settings page.
